items.exampleEn: Don't worry about the test. You'll do well.
items.exampleZh: 別擔心考試，你會考得很好。

items.exampleEn: I always do homework right after school.
items.exampleZh: 我總是一放學就寫功課。

items.exampleEn: Whose turn is it to do the dishes tonight?
We have breakfast at seven on weekdays.
Have fun at the party tonight!
items.exampleZh: 今晚的派對玩得開心喔！

items.exampleEn: Don't be afraid to make a mistake.
It's easy for her to make friends.

items.sentenceEn: After dinner, Dad always does the dishes.
items.sentenceZh: 晚餐後，爸爸總是負責洗碗。

items.audioEn: I didn't have breakfast this morning, so I'm really hungry now.
items.audioZh: 我今天早上沒吃早餐，所以現在好餓。
items.questionZh: 說話的人為什麼現在很餓？
options: Got up very early this morning

items.sentenceEn: My mom always worries about me when I'm late.
items.sentenceZh: 我晚回家的時候，我媽媽總是會擔心我。

items.sentenceEn: I made friends with a boy from Korea.
items.sentenceZh: 我和一個從韓國來的男生交了朋友。

items.stemEn: I ____ on the math test and lost two points.
items.stemZh: 我數學考試犯了一個錯，被扣了兩分。

items.stemEn: The kids ____ at the water park all afternoon. They didn't want to go home.
items.stemZh: 孩子們整個下午在水上樂園玩得很開心，都不想回家了。

items.passageEn: Mia moved to a new city last month. On her first day at school, she worried about making friends. In English class, she made a mistake when she read in front of everyone, but nobody laughed at her. At lunch, a girl named Rosa sat down next to her. They talked and had fun together. Now Mia and Rosa do homework together after school, and Mia isn't worried anymore.
items.passageZh: Mia 上個月搬到一個新城市。第一天上學時，她很擔心交不到朋友。英文課時，她在大家面前朗讀時犯了一個錯，但沒有人嘲笑她。午餐時，一個叫 Rosa 的女生在她旁邊坐下。她們聊天，玩得很開心。現在 Mia 和 Rosa 放學後一起寫功課，Mia 已經不再擔心了。

questions.questionZh: Mia 第一天上學時擔心什麼？
現在 Mia 和 Rosa 放學後一起做什麼？

items.promptZh: 我妹妹每天晚上在她的房間裡寫功課。
referenceEn: My sister does homework in her room every evening.
My younger sister does homework in her room every night.
Every evening, my little sister does homework in her room.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 does homework、does her homework 等
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 works on her homework 等）也算對
每天的習慣用現在簡單式（例如 does、always does 等）
「妹妹」可寫，例如 sister、younger sister、little sister 等

items.promptZh: 服務生昨天算我們的帳單時犯了一個錯。
referenceEn: The waiter made a mistake with our bill yesterday.
Yesterday the waiter made a mistake on our bill.
The waiter made a mistake on our bill yesterday.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 made a mistake 等
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 made an error、got our bill wrong 等）也算對
昨天的事用過去式（例如 made 等）
「帳單」前的介系詞可用，例如 with our bill、on our bill 等
